name: Proxima Fusion
description: Designs fusion power plants based on stellarators, a type of reactor that uses magnetic fields to confine plasma. The company spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics.

name: Avelios Medical
description: Builds modular hospital software for clinical workflows and patient documentation. Its tools help care teams capture structured treatment data during everyday work.

name: Symphera
description: Develops surgical instruments for minimally invasive procedures. Its system is designed to let surgeons switch tools during laparoscopic surgery without manually swapping instruments.

name: AUDAVIS
description: Develops AI-assisted financial auditing software. Its Artificial Auditor helps audit teams analyze transactions and check the quality of financial data.

name: Auxilius
description: Builds software for enterprise governance, risk, and compliance. It turns policies into rules that run automatically and produce evidence for internal monitoring and audits.

name: lytra
description: Builds AI software for the after-sales service teams of machinery manufacturers. It automates service requests and helps operators find product and process knowledge.
